display_long_description:
Dodgeball: 4Elements instantly transforms your living room, kitchen, or any space you choose into an action-packed dodgeball arena! This fast-paced, intense game leverages the full power of Meta Quest's Mixed Reality (MR) technology, allowing you to play with friends either remotely or in the same room using Shared Space.

🌪️ It's All Over in 90 Seconds Matches are incredibly fast and chaotic—you only have 90 seconds to prove your dominance!!

Simple Rules, Deep Strategy:

Choose Your Power: Select from 9 unique characters, each attuned to a specific element: Fire, Water, Air, or Earth. Each character comes with distinct ball visuals and shields. Protect yourself with an ice shield or attack with a blazing fireball!

Attack and Score: Your goal is to hit the clover leaves on your opponent. Aim with your hand up and click to throw the ball. Every 4 leaves hit equals 1 point. The player with the most points when the timer hits zero wins!

Master Your Defense: With your hand down, click to instantly deploy your elemental shield. Quick reflexes and well-timed blocks are the keys to victory.

In Dodgeball: 4Elements, you don't just throw a ball; you become a master of the elements in the real world. Designed specifically for Quest 3 and Quest 3S & Future Devices.

Download this visually stunning game now and dive right into the action!
